name: Ivrit Sheli — העברית שלי

durable_demo.boundary: A free Render service runs the 2.12.3 source as staging for a private pilot, not as production. Moved from Singapore to Frankfurt on 2026-09-12 and renamed, so the URL no longer says staging. Verified against the live host that day: /health/live at 0.149 s against 0.287 s from the old Singapore service, /health/ready with postgresql true and a 240-entry dictionary, /version reporting 2.12.3, a strict production CSP with default-src 'self', HSTS for a year with includeSubDomains, a Secure HttpOnly SameSite=lax session cookie, and a Google OAuth redirect using PKCE with the exact new callback. /health/ready still costs about 2 s in both regions because the database is far from either. The free plan sleeps after 15 minutes and the wake-up is not a fixed cost: two measurements the same day gave 38.6 s and 218 s, so a first request can take minutes. Anyone checking the service should wait before concluding it is down. The human Hebrew-content and first-learner gates remain open, and no v2.12.3 tag exists. The historical Railway service is offline.

summary: The 2.12.3 source of a trilingual Hebrew-learning PWA with 240 exact semantic scenes, clearer counting visuals, Alphabet Studio and deterministic coaching, published on main and running as a private-pilot staging service on Render Free. The latest tagged source release remains v2.12.2.

candidate.coverage: Structured A0-A2 with an explicitly experimental B1/B2 Lab
candidate.personal_coach: Reviewed deterministic LocalPersonalCoach with bounded feedback
candidate.speech: Optional self-hosted Faster Whisper small worker for Hebrew CPU INT8 transcription with a 20-second private pilot limit
candidate.reminders: Optional standards-based Web Push with one reminder per learner/local day
candidate.verification: The source version surfaces identify the private 2.12.3 candidate, while TEST_REPORT.md scopes its local runtime, browser and test evidence. The latest published GitHub source release remains v2.12.2; neither version is durable-host or deployment proof.
candidate.release_gate: The 2.12.3 candidate remains local. Publication and deployment each require separate approval, with isolated HTTPS staging, two-real-account isolation, backup and restore, provider checks, human visual recognition, and the mother pilot still open.

visual_proof.state: The private 2.12.3 candidate defines 240 reviewed concepts and 240 exact semantic scenes.
visual_proof.interactive_browser_qa: The privacy-reviewed 2.12.3 candidate README selection represents the 240-scene candidate and is recorded in assets/readme/proof/2.12.3/manifest.json. Its five WebP assets and non-looping GIF passed source-manifest, hash, two-pass byte-identity, full-size, GitHub-scale, privacy and grayscale review on 2026-08-27. A fresh FastAPI-served 2.12.3 process also passed entry-asset discovery and a bounded Playwright smoke before capture. The immutable assets/readme/proof/2.12.2 directory remains historical published-release evidence. The full 2.12.3 Playwright matrix, contact-sheet recognition, provider verification and deployment remain separate gates.

oauth.boundary: Historical 2.4.0 production evidence verified identity-only Google sign-in, reload continuity, logout and signed-out persistence on 2026-07-21. It does not prove current hosted availability, a live GitHub session, re-login after logout, provider connector calls, two-real-user isolation or backup restoration.
